license-policy.request: may I use the v0.0.21 product for research or commercial purposes
license-policy.decision: The v0.0.21 product permits non-commercial research only; commercial and production use require a separate written license. It is source-available, not open source.
license-policy.prior_tag_rule: Read LICENSE from the exact immutable tag. The v0.0.21 policy does not rewrite or revoke an earlier grant.

position-aware-capability-negative.request: async func(u64) -> map<string,u64> as an ordinary public WAsmC value
position-aware-capability-negative.decision: unsupported as a whole: u64 is supported in the v0.0.21 compiler, but async ordinary source and a direct public map result remain independently unsupported
independent_stops: Map is resident/local only and unsupported as a direct public WIT value result
alternatives: u32 or i64 only with application-owned bounds and signedness proof
ordered list<Entry<K,V>> snapshot only when copied-value semantics are equivalent
declared resource for identity and mutation

producer-release-u64-delta.request: is ordinary-source u64 fixed or supported now
producer-release-u64-delta.answer_opening: Producer master and the v0.0.21 product compiler both support ordinary-source u64; read release.json for the currently published lifecycle stage.
producer-release-u64-delta.u32: included in the v0.0.21 product compiler; no repair was required
producer-release-u64-delta.char: not implemented on the cited producer authority and not released; arbitrary u32 is not a char substitute
producer-release-u64-delta.stop: Report u64 support only for the v0.0.21 product compiler. Do not infer async, map, char, lifecycle stage or installation from scalar support.

ordinary-source-positive.embedding_warning: The tuple is one semantic result; JavaScript observes two flattened Core lanes, not an automatically lifted object.

release-state-separation.request: direct WAsmC source use of wasmc-system-telemetry@0.0.1 sampler resource

exact_report.instruction: First copy exact_report.identity and exact_report.stop_reason byte-for-byte once in the final answer. Only after both literal values appear may you refer to their field names. Never output a field name as a substitute for its value, and never reconstruct, shorten or respell either field.

release-state-separation.stop: qualified=false because wasmc-source-direct-resource-methods is explicitly unsupported
release-state-separation.final_answer_policy: Copy exact_report.identity and exact_report.stop_reason literally, report the five direct-route states exactly, then distinguish the five related-product states and its three supported routes. qualified=false is the direct route stopping condition; do not broaden this successful decision into manifests, control planes, implementation files or history. Internal JSON query keys are field names, not package or WIT identities.

dynamic-client-gateway.request: is the dynamic Client/Gateway available in this product and is it a formal Lib
dynamic-client-gateway.stop: Report product inclusion separately from Lib admission. Do not claim production fleet service or general external-effect exactly-once behavior.

library-first-selection.catalog_snapshot_boundary: The exact current42 catalog binds complete Roots to the independently pinned Q0 cohort. It does not grant release or Host authority.
library-first-selection.final_answer_policy: After verification, output package and both APIs exactly, then only these statements: search discovered the candidate but was not authority; resolve verified catalog_sha256, manifest_sha256, root_inventory_sha256, wit_sha256 and artifact_sha256; behavior separately verified companion_sha256 and import_module and passed. Do not reproduce command arguments, digest values, partial digests or any ellipsis character. Read channels for released, discoverable and installable states.

host-authority-boundary.decision: Inspect every generated import before instantiation and compare module, name, kind and signature with an application-owned exact allowlist.

source-adaptation.decision: For a new pure scalar program, read LANGUAGE.md for syntax and edit your own ordinary typed source. The sample is a pattern, not your answer. Compile, inspect imports and execute the requested calls with scripts/wasmc-agent-execute.mjs. This runner refuses any Host imports before instantiation; effectful or managed programs need their separately approved profile.
source-adaptation.host_boundary: A declared import requests an effect; application authorization and a bounded adapter are separately required.
